Explain what this step does and why, and copy each command you ran into a
bash chunk. R chunks run from the top of the repository.

#Change directory to gtdbtk
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/gtdbtk

#topbins we want to copy a file corresponding to that bin into our genomes folder.
#create the loop
while read bin;do echo $bin;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

#each bin we prepare a file
while read bin;do echo "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa";done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
#preform the copy
while read bin;do cp "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa" genomes;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
#check to see if it worked
ls genomes


#we can now run the classifcation workflow
#create new script file labeled as run_gtdbtk.sh in the gtdbtk directory
#copy code below into the script file
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --time=120
#SBATCH --ntasks=2 --mem=56gb

#submit file
sbatch run_gtdbtk.sh

#Check to see if the classifcation worked
ls -l out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv

#copy summary into the gtdbtk folder
cp out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv .

echo "Starting gtdbtk in $(pwd) at $(date)"

shopt -s expand_aliases
alias gtdbtk='apptainer run -B /pvol:/pvol,/pvol/data/mg/gtdbtkdata/release207_v2/:/refdata /pvol/data/sif/gtdbtk.sif'

gtdbtk classify_wf -x fa --cpus 2 --genome_dir genomes --out_dir out --skip_ani_screen

echo "Finished gtdbtk in $(pwd) at $(date)"
Taxonomic classification of the most complete bins with GTDB-Tk. Commands for this step were run in `gtdbtk/`.
